exceptions.reason: Parents @imgly/background-removal 1.7.0 and @jimp/types 1.6.0 require Zod 3; latest 3.x is 3.25.76. Patched 4.6.6 is an incompatible major.
exceptions.mitigation: No application Zod import or user-controlled collection schema. Background removal validates fixed application configuration (progress callback and defaults), not image bytes, with no constrained collection schema. @jimp/types has no source imports. Reassess any configuration/schema exposure; isolated CI without secrets.
